description: Convert a color between any two of the 221 color spaces, identity included, in each space's conventional ranges (rgb 0-255, oklch L 0-1 / C 0-0.4 / H 0-360, lab L 0-100 …). The color goes in as a CSS string (`color`) or as channel values (`from` + `values`); a batch as `colors` – tuples in `from`, CSS strings, or both. Out-of-range in, unclamped out: `inRange` flags each channel against the target's conventional range (rgb below 0 means outside sRGB); null = undefined at that coordinate.

colors.description: a batch: one tuple (in `from`) or CSS string per color, e.g. [[255, 128, 0], '#00ff80', 'oklch(0.7 0.1 50)']

from.description: source space id, e.g. 'rgb', 'oklch', 'lab', 'slog3', 'rec709' (the 'spaces' tool lists all 221)

to.description: target space id, e.g. 'rgb', 'oklch', 'lab', 'slog3', 'rec709' (the 'spaces' tool lists all 221)

values.description: one color in the source space, e.g. [255, 128, 0] for rgb

name: convert
title: Convert color
